title: Reset the three-Action rehearsal fixture for run 5 (one Action's text and the Plan date on fixture main; rejects run 4's complete proposal only if still pending; no production change)
problem: Run 4 of the three-Action rehearsal left fixture main at its reset head 9642005f2fdca40a4c8859d64ee28e3361df0056 (one commit on run 3's reset head 4375aafeef38f0ee339a300406c8a865dbb916dc, itself one commit on run 2's reset head 0d3d2cedc5548da41896201688a1dc0210208ea4, one commit on G1's genesis), a passed development attempt for write-start-marker's run-4 input (revision 7843e2eb12f9…; run 3's was e22c8cfadd0b…, run 2's 7a8dd4f5960f… and the original 959a3b12c686…), and its candidate preserved on branch claude/write-start-marker-20261005T220000438Z and pull request #4 at 79c6bae937255964cf0453c163ece0c36bb1985a (which includes the worker's terminal-recovery preservation commit), beside run 3's branch claude/write-start-marker-20261005T184707757Z and pull request #3 at 50d1eab84e385a5566119831c82f5a6d32e752fd, run 2's branch claude/write-start-marker-20261005T155147519Z and pull request #2 at 7f1390376f4d49215cd29fd98145d40198475613 and run 1's branch claude/write-start-marker-20261004T170245861Z and pull request #1 at 58bcd9155cf64836994045ca63a7707d8b9ebe75. Run 4 stalled at integration because its agent's drafted complete Ask file was never archived and was committed on top of the settlement (Issue #981). Arcadia never relaunches a passed development attempt for an unchanged requirement input, so run 5 needs a fifth input revision. A pending Agent Ask proposal naming write-start-marker makes the dispatch gate answer 'decision' and the tick launch nothing (Issue #968). Run 4's own complete proposal (complete-write-start-marker-run4-2026-10-05) was settled accepted (fixture main stayed at 9642005f), so it no longer gates; any proposal still pending for the fixture would gate run 5 the same way, and run 4's would if it were pending. The 2026-10-05, run-3 and run-4 resets are consumed and retired from use: they reset only from G1's genesis or run 2's or run 3's reset head.
desired_effect: Rewrite only write-start-marker's next_action in the fixture Plan (a run-5 note on the original sentence, which tells the agent to record completion under the unused Agent Ask request id complete-write-start-marker-run5-2026-10-06, because runs 2, 3 and 4's completion ids complete-write-start-marker-2026-10-05, complete-write-start-marker-run3-2026-10-05 and complete-write-start-marker-run4-2026-10-05 are settled, and to leave git status clean after settling: settlement archives the drafted Ask file itself, so it must not commit or keep a copy, and deletes a stray draft) and set the Plan's updated: date to the reset's UTC date, which changes its requirement input revision a fifth time while its acceptance criteria, responsibility, execution, title and the other two Actions stay byte-identical. docs sync applies a Plan whose date is equal to or later than its record's (src/docs/sync.ts stalenessOf), so a reset on 2026-10-06 bumps the date line from run 4's 2026-10-05 (validated by the real docs sync before the commit); a host date before the Plan's date refuses with the remedy. Validate the amendment with Arcadia's own discovery, a throwaway dry-run docs sync, resolveReadySet and requirementIdentity, and a read-only dry-run docs sync against the live workspace that must report write-start-marker as an update. Refuse every pending Agent Ask proposal or Decision that gates a fixture Action, and every pending fixture proposal, except exactly run 4's complete proposal, which it rejects through arcadia agent-ask settle --disposition rejected (preview, then --apply with that exact fingerprint, ARCADIA_WORKSPACE inline on that one command and never exported) before the commit only if it is still pending; an already rejected or accepted one is left as it is. In every case it then confirms the gate is clear. Commit once on fixture main, push without force, run docs sync, and write a receipt carrying the new fixture head, all four earlier candidates' tips, every fixture proposal's state and the superseded proposal, which the run-5 G6 and G7 bind. Run it from a terminal: ARCADIA_REHEARSAL_GITHUB_REPO=pmark/arcadia-three-action-rehearsal-20261004 /Users/pmark/Dev/MR/Arcadia/arcadia/artifacts/generated/operator-scripts/reset-three-action-rehearsal-fixture-run5-2026-10-06.sh run

parameters.ARCADIA_REHEARSAL_GITHUB_REPO: Required environment variable: the exact owner/name of the fixture repository G1 prepared. The owner must be the authenticated gh user and the name must match ^arcadia-three-action-rehearsal(-[a-z0-9]{1,24})?$. Launched from /runs without it, the script refuses with a receipt and changes nothing.

does: Refuses before any other step unless ARCADIA_REHEARSAL_GITHUB_REPO is exactly owner/name with a safe disposable-fixture name; requires the Arcadia checkout clean on main, ARCADIA_WORKSPACE not exported, this descriptor's agentAsk declaring exactly run 4's proposal, the CLI default workspace martianrover from user config, and production readable, Inactive and with zero live admissions (rechecked immediately before the proposal settle and before the push)

Requires the earlier runs' records: a succeeded G1 receipt for this exact repository (its genesis), a succeeded run-4 reset receipt (reset-three-action-rehearsal-fixture-run4-2026-10-05) whose newHead is 9642005f2fdca40a4c8859d64ee28e3361df0056, previousMain run 3's reset head 4375aafeef38f0ee339a300406c8a865dbb916dc and genesis that genesis, and run 4's terminal Off: the latest restore-terminal-off-three-action-rehearsal-run4-2026-10-05 receipt past its launch guard must be succeeded with offState confirmed, from run 20261006T011557Z-3871 or later

Requires the local fixture clean on main with the exact manifest, origin, single G1 genesis root and run 4's reset head as one commit on run 3's reset head, itself one commit on run 2's reset head 0d3d2cedc5548da41896201688a1dc0210208ea4, itself one commit on that genesis; the Project three-action-rehearsal registered from this fixture under G1's registration marker (read-only probe) with no prepared or running fixture Session; the GitHub repository owned by the gh user, private, not archived, not a fork and carrying G1's disposable-fixture description

Requires runs 1, 2, 3 and 4's candidates exactly as reconciled: local branch, GitHub branch and pull request head of claude/write-start-marker-20261004T170245861Z / #1 at 58bcd9155cf64836994045ca63a7707d8b9ebe75, claude/write-start-marker-20261005T155147519Z / #2 at 7f1390376f4d49215cd29fd98145d40198475613, claude/write-start-marker-20261005T184707757Z / #3 at 50d1eab84e385a5566119831c82f5a6d32e752fd and claude/write-start-marker-20261005T220000438Z / #4 at 79c6bae937255964cf0453c163ece0c36bb1985a, checked before any change and again after the push; records all twelve tips with each pull request's state in candidatesBefore and candidatesAfter

Renders the amendment from run 4's reset tree into dot-directories of its run directory that Arcadia's discovery skips, and refuses unless only the fixture Plan changed (write-start-marker's next_action and the Plan's updated: date), the amended fixture passes G1's own validation rules (zero docs-sync errors, pointer at write-start-marker, serial depends_on, only write-start-marker ready), the genesis and run-4 trees carry the recorded input revisions 959a3b12c686… and 7843e2eb12f9…, the amended input revision differs from those and from run 2's 7a8dd4f5960f… and run 3's e22c8cfadd0b… with an unchanged criteria fingerprint, and the other Actions' identities are unchanged; reads the live attempt lineage read-only and refuses if the amended input already has an attempt, or if a run-1, run-2, run-3 or run-4 Session that passed write-start-marker is still prepared or running, was not preserved by the worker, or has uncommitted work in its worktree

Runs a read-only dry-run docs sync of the amended tree against the live workspace and refuses unless it reports write-start-marker as an update (not skipped as older than its record) with no error and no skipped Action

Reads, read-only through Arcadia's own resolveOperatorGate and listUnsettledAgentAskProposals, every pending Agent Ask proposal and open Decision that would gate any of the three fixture Actions and every pending proposal for the fixture Project, and refuses untouched on any other than run 4's complete-write-start-marker-run4-2026-10-05, or when the request id complete-write-start-marker-run5-2026-10-06 that the amended next_action names is already used in agent_ask_proposals; that proposal must match this descriptor's agentAsk exactly (intent complete, target action/write-start-marker, Project three-action-rehearsal); records every fixture proposal's request id and disposition before and after

Only if that proposal is still pending, and with this operator press as the operator's disposition, rejects only that proposal (by its exact proposal row id) through arcadia agent-ask settle --disposition rejected with the fixed settlement request id reset-three-action-rehearsal-fixture-run5-2026-10-06-reject-run4-complete: a preview that must report a document-free, queue-free rejection of exactly that proposal, then --apply --preview with that exact fingerprint, with ARCADIA_WORKSPACE set inline on that one command; records the fingerprint, reads the settlement back when the apply's output is not proof, and refuses unless the gate is then clear. The settlement row and its pending Discord notification are the only workspace writes besides docs sync. An already-landed rejection under that request id is recognized on a rerun and not repeated; a proposal already rejected or accepted elsewhere (run 4's was settled accepted), or absent, is left exactly as it is, provided fixture main is run 4's reset head (or this script's own reset commit on it) and the gate then reads clear

Only after all of that, commits exactly the validated Plan file on fixture main (one commit on run 4's reset head) and pushes refs/heads/main without force; then confirms GitHub main is the new head, rechecks all four candidates, runs arcadia docs sync --project three-action-rehearsal --apply and confirms write-start-marker updated and each of the three Actions synced exactly once

Resumes safely: a reset commit already made by this script but not pushed is re-validated byte for byte and pushed; one already pushed proceeds to docs sync; after a succeeded run a rerun refuses as already reset

Writes a timestamped receipt under runs/<timestamp-pid>/ (githubRepository, genesis, previousMain, newHead, remoteMainAfter, candidatesBefore, candidatesAfter, fixtureProposalsBefore, fixtureProposalsAfter, supersededProposal with its proposal id, state, settlement request id and preview fingerprint, run5CompletionRequestId, actionTextRevision with the original, previous and new input revisions) on success and refusal, plus a failure handoff on refusal
never_does: Never previews, activates or deactivates production, and never creates, presses or changes a Grant or a Decision

Never settles, accepts or edits any Agent Ask proposal other than run 4's complete-write-start-marker-run4-2026-10-05, never accepts that one, and never settles it when its preview would write a document or place a queue entry
Never changes any Action other than write-start-marker, its acceptance criteria, status or responsibility, PROJECT.md, the genesis check or the CI workflow
Never touches run 1's, run 2's, run 3's or run 4's branches, worktrees or pull requests #1, #2, #3 and #4, and never comments on, merges, closes or edits a pull request
Never force-pushes, rewrites, resets or rebases fixture history, and never deletes, renames, archives or changes the visibility of a repository
Never settles, commits or pushes before the amended fixture validates, and never edits the workspace database directly
Never restarts a service or worker, reinstalls the broker, or launches a Session
Never guesses or defaults the repository identifier, and never exports ARCADIA_WORKSPACE (it is set inline on the one settle command only)

success.effect: Fixture main on GitHub and locally is one reset commit on run 4's reset head that changes only write-start-marker's next_action and the Plan's updated: date (when later; on 2026-10-06 it moves from 2026-10-05); run 4's complete proposal was left as it was when already settled (live: accepted) or rejected through the governed settle if still pending, and nothing gates the fixture; docs sync applied the amendment with zero errors; the receipt carries the new fixture head, the previous main, runs 1, 2, 3 and 4's untouched candidate tips, every fixture proposal's state and the superseded proposal. Production is unchanged.
success.next: If Arcadia main moved on a runtime path since the last install, run recover-arcadia-host-services from a terminal with ARCADIA_WORKSPACE set inline on that one command (never exported). Then run the run-5 G6 preflight preflight-three-action-rehearsal-run5-2026-10-06, which binds this receipt, and have the operator press the run-5 G7 grant-production-three-action-rehearsal-run5-2026-10-06 within 30 minutes of its passing receipt without pushing to Arcadia main, reinstalling, restarting services or running any G8 in between.

failure.effect: The receipt and failure handoff name the failed precondition, the fixture state found, whether this run settled run 4's proposal (with its preview fingerprint) and whether it committed or pushed. Nothing was forced, rewritten or deleted, no other proposal was settled, and production, Grants and runs 1, 2, 3 and 4's candidates were not touched.
failure.next: Correct the named precondition and rerun with the same identifier; a rejection, commit or push this script already made is recognized and resumed, not repeated. If the handoff names other pending proposals or Decisions, settle them through their own governed path first. If it says the fixture moved by another path, do not edit it by hand: ask for a new reviewed reset.
